interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. Supports project onboarding, bounded Guardian runs through the compatible REST v1 API, explicit approval review, server-side app integration, production-readiness checks, and evidence-first verification. The package includes a small optional REST CLI for an existing authorized Nexus endpoint. It does not bundle a hosted model, credentials, or an MCP server, and it never grants filesystem, GitHub, deployment, browser, or infrastructure permissions by itself.
capabilities: Plan isolated Nexus projects and Guardian permissions
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks
Plan Lucio, Ember, Nexus Code, and future app integrations
Audit verification, tenant isolation, and production readiness
defaultPrompt: Help me configure separate Nexus Starship Guardians projects for Lucio and Ember.
Inspect my Nexus run and explain any pending approvals.
Review whether this Nexus integration has enough evidence for release.

name: nexus-starship-guardians
description: Project-scoped Guardian operations, approvals, integration guidance, and verified runtime workflows for Nexus Starship Guardians.
